title: Roost Traces
description: Roost Traces is a small NeoForge companion mod that makes Ice and Fire CE surface dragon roosts part of the Create ReAutomated progression loop.
body:
# Roost Traces

Roost Traces makes Ice and Fire CE surface dragon roosts part of the Create ReAutomated resource loop.

When a roost generates, the mod places one compatible Create ReAutomated node directly in the roost floor and registers it with Create ReAutomated: Traces as a node-only Trace Finder target. No visible trace outcrop or platform is added.

Node pools are datapack-driven, so modpacks can choose different rewards for fire, ice, and lightning roosts. Placement is lightweight, avoids force-loading chunks, and uses bounded retries for recoverable failures.
